title: lRP - Main
description: A resource pack inspired by the Applied Energistics 2 Mod interface
body:
# English(US)
This resource pack revamps your game's interface and textures, transforming the look and feel to mirror the sleek, futuristic design of Applied Energistics 2. Experience clean lines, digital sophistication, and a fully optimized, modern UI. Perfect for builders and tech enthusiasts seeking a structured aesthetic.---_Gemini_

# 中文(中国)
资源包修改了GUI看上去更像是**Applied Energistics 2**的风格 并额外加了些东西 ~~(其实我也不知道主要改的什么)~~
